claimsNote: Every flag is literally false. No runtime in this repository can issue, present, validate, or honour an approval, and no barrier can reach a human resolution because no runtime implements integrated barriers either. approverAuthenticationClaim is false in a stronger sense than the others: this contract defines no signature, PKI, or attestation at all, so it makes forgery of the binding detectable and does NOT make impersonation of the approver detectable. eventSchemaIntegrationClaim is false because spec/event.schema.json still declares an open data object; closing it per event type is integration-lane work this contract does not perform. Flipping any flag to true must be a deliberate, reviewed edit made by the lane that implements the corresponding behaviour, never an inference from this corpus.

provenance.note: Every expectation is derived only from approval-semantics.md and the three approval schemas. No value is copied from another conformance fixture and no value is imported from a language runtime. The BarrierDecision document embedded here is constructed from the frozen shape in integrated-barrier-semantics.md and is validated against barrier-decision.schema.json by the oracle, so a drift in that frozen shape fails this corpus rather than passing silently.
